bequeath.definition: v. leave or give by will after one's death
bequeath.translation:
vt. 遗赠, 遗留
[法] 遗赠, 遗留...给

bequeathal.definition: n. The act of bequeathing; bequeathment; bequest.
bequeathal.translation: a. 遗赠的, 遗留的

bequeathed.translation: v. 将…遗赠给( bequeath的过去式和过去分词 ); 将（知识等）传给（后人）

bequeathing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Bequeath
bequeathing.translation: v. 将…遗赠给( bequeath的现在分词 ); 将（知识等）传给（后人）

bequeathment.definition:
n. The act of bequeathing, or the state of being
   bequeathed; a bequest.

bequeaths.definition: v leave or give by will after one's death
bequeaths.translation: v. 将…遗赠给( bequeath的第三人称单数 ); 将（知识等）传给（后人）

bequest.definition: n. (law) a gift of personal property by will
bequest.translation:
n. 遗赠物, 遗产, 遗赠
[经] 遗产

bequested.definition:
past tense of bequest
n. (law) a gift of personal property by will
bequested.translation:
(bequest 的过去时) n. 遗赠物, 遗产, 遗赠
[经] 遗产

bequests.definition: n. (law) a gift of personal property by will
bequests.translation: n. 遗赠( bequest的复数形式 ); 遗产, 遗赠物

bequia.translation: [地名] [圣文森特和格林纳丁斯] 贝基亚岛
